in_english.name: Sawah
in_english.meaning: Sawah means beauty and sublimity in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sawah originates from the Arabic root س-و-ح (s-w-ḥ), which signifies elevation, sublimity, or beauty. It connotes a sense of grandeur and magnificence. In Islamic tradition, names derived from this root are often associated with positive attributes and are considered auspicious. Sawah, as a given name, symbolizes beauty, elegance, and high status.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, the name "Sawah" is believed to symbolize a place of serenity and prosperity, resonating with the concept of Paradise as described in the Quran (76:19-20, 31, 32, 37, 38). It represents a land that offers an abundance of sustenance and beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, "Sawah" can be interpreted as the purposeful and intentional cultivation of a virtuous and righteous character, as described in Surah Al-Kahf (18:28) – "Make thine invocation to God, and sacrifice; it is better for you." The cultivation of one's character brings growth, transformation, and ultimately, a deeper connection with the Divine. In this sense, "Sawah" is an ongoing spiritual journey, an invitation to strive for self-improvement and moral excellence, reflecting the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh): "The one who turns his heart towards Allah will not be deprived in this life and in the Hereafter." (Bukhari)
